LogRocket (LogRocket, Inc., Delaware; Boston, MA; acquired by Perforce Software 2024) is a session replay, product analytics, and error tracking platform. No publicly accessible SLA exists — all pages return HTTP 403 and trust.logrocket.com does not resolve. An "Uptime SLA" is listed as an Enterprise-tier feature on the pricing page, but specific uptime percentages, credit structures, and claim processes are not publicly disclosed and are negotiated as private Enterprise contract terms.
